title: CreateSigmaJobRequest
description: Request to create an Auto Sigma rule generation job from malware sample hashes.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the Auto Sigma job.

query.title: Query
query.description: The query used to select files to build rules for

EndDate.description: Latest date to include in the query, defaults to today in UTC

StartDate.description: Earliest date to include in the query (cannot be before 2023-11-01)
